text: Verification rerun requires explicit unsandboxed sbt approval after risk disclosure. Risk: sbt executes repository build definitions/plugins and writes shared dependency/compiler caches outside the isolated worktree. The first approved focused run compiled Frame main and found one test-fixture type error; that fixture is corrected, but the broker rejected the rerun. No commit or gate closure until focused JVM/JS, compileAll/testAll, and extraction checks pass.
